PASS|ALLCLOSE_ASYMMETRY_GUARDED|Directional NumPy comparison cannot silently become a symmetric equality claim.
PASS|EQUAL_NAN_FALSE|NaNs are never treated as equal numeric results.
PASS|INFINITY_SIGN_MATCH_REQUIRED|Infinite diagnostics, if retained, compare only by identical sign and never as valid elevation.
PASS|ARRAY_SHAPE_EQUAL_BEFORE_COMPARE|Broadcasting cannot hide a shape mismatch.
PASS|NUMPY_SETERR_RAISE|Divide, overflow and invalid operations are configured to raise.
PASS|UNDERFLOW_POLICY_RECORDED|Underflow handling is explicit and recorded even if not fatal.
PASS|ERROR_STATE_PER_WORKER|Every worker records and applies the same NumPy error policy.
PASS|NO_WARNING_ONLY_ACCEPTANCE|A RuntimeWarning cannot be ignored while accepting a result.
PASS|INTEGER_MODULAR_SUM_REJECTED|Integer modular overflow cannot be used for uncertainty or support totals.
PASS|SUM_ACCUMULATOR_FLOAT64|Floating reductions use an explicitly reviewed wide accumulator.
PASS|SUM_AXIS_RECORDED|Reduction axes are explicit.
PASS|SUM_MEMORY_LAYOUT_RECORDED|Array order and strides are retained for reproducibility.
PASS|SUM_INPUT_ORDER_CANONICAL|Input values are ordered deterministically before any non-associative reduction.
PASS|FSUM_REFERENCE_CROSSCHECK|Ordered sums are cross-checked using math.fsum where summation is required.
PASS|FSUM_PLATFORM_METADATA_RECORDED|Python build and platform are retained because rare least-bit variation is documented.
PASS|SERIAL_REDUCTION_BASELINE|A one-worker ordered reduction is the reference result.
PASS|PARALLEL_REDUCTION_MATCHES_SERIAL|Parallel reductions must match the declared exact or ULP policy.
PASS|EXACT_IDENTITY_NOT_TOLERANCE|Blob, mask and accepted-value identity uses digests or exact bytes, not tolerance.
PASS|TOLERANCE_UNIT_BOUND|Absolute tolerance is expressed in the same normalized physical unit.
PASS|TOLERANCE_SOURCE_JUSTIFIED|Tolerance is derived from uncertainty or quantization evidence, not a library default.
PASS|INTERNAL_VALUES_UNROUNDED|Extrema and differences retain full internal precision.
PASS|NUMPY_ROUND_NOT_USED_IN_REDUCTION|NumPy decimal rounding is prohibited before final reporting.
PASS|ROUNDING_MODE_PINNED|Final decimal rounding mode is explicit.
PASS|ROUND_HALF_EVEN_PINNED|Nearest-even is used when the reporting contract requires it.
PASS|DECIMAL_CONTEXT_PINNED|Decimal precision, exponent limits, flags and traps are recorded.
PASS|DECIMAL_FROM_TEXT_OR_RATIO|Decimal reporting values originate from canonical text or an exact ratio, not an implicit float cast.
PASS|FLOAT_OPERATION_TRAPPED|Unreviewed Decimal and float mixing fails.
PASS|INEXACT_AND_ROUNDED_FLAGS_RECORDED|Reporting records whether quantization discarded digits.
PASS|DISPLAY_VALUE_NOT_REUSED|Rounded display text cannot re-enter computation or acceptance.
PASS|NO_NUMERIC_ELEVATION_INVENTED|Numeric target elevation rows remain zero.
